title: The book cannot be opened (fault injected)
note: If opening the database or updating it throws, a recovery screen replaces the app, in the same plain block as the crash screen: "The book could not open", one line on what Export does (it copies the files exactly as they are, and does not say the letters are safe), "Try again, or restart the phone.", and two actions: Try again and Export what's readable. No delete, reset or rebuild exists here. Reached only by a preview-only switch (?fault=launch-once); on a phone it follows a failed database open or update.
text: The book could not open Export saves a copy of the recordings and book files it can read, exactly as they are. Try again, or restart the phone. Try again Export what's readable
